title: Power BI Gateway Tuning - Slow Upload/Send Speed After Mashup, Any Tips?
description: Power BI Gateway Tuning - Slow Upload/Send Speed After Mashup, Any Tips?
extracted:
## Practical diagnosis and tuning steps mentioned

| Topic | Details explicitly stated |
|---|---|
| Initial bottleneck observed | Mashup read finished in about **40 minutes**, then **CPU usage dropped to 2%**, but **sending data alone took over 80 minutes**, resulting in a **total refresh time of nearly 2 hours** for a **16 GB compressed data model**. |
| Gateway configuration already tried | **StreamBeforeRequestCompletes** option with **serializeAs=TRUE** was already enabled in the gateway configuration, but throughput after the mashup phase was still reduced. |
| Whitelisting | **Already taken care of**. |
| Network considerations mentioned in reply | The gateway’s upload performance is **inherently constrained by available network bandwidth**. The connection from the server running the gateway to the network gateway, plus **internet upload speed**, influence performance. |
| Latency observation from user | **Latency remained consistently between 129 and 136 ms**. |
| Packet loss observation from user | **There were no packet losses before or after the tuning**. |
| System resource diagnosis advised | The reply recommended monitoring **all system resources**, **not just CPU**, to identify bottlenecks on the local machine. |
| Additional network troubleshooting suggested | Attempt to **upload a file to an Azure destination located in the same region as the Power BI tenant** to gain further troubleshooting insight. |

## What worked for the user

| Change | Result explicitly stated |
|---|---|
| **Fact tables parallelism** adjustment | Tuned the model to load data in **40 minutes**. |
| **DLL settings** adjustment | Tuned the model to load data in **40 minutes**. |
| Switching from **views** to **tables** | The user stated that **if they switch to tables, the refresh should complete in approximately 34 minutes**. This is described as a projected/expected result, not confirmed as completed. |

## Measured results

| Measure | Before tuning | After tuning / current state |
|---|---|---|
| Mashup read time | **About 40 minutes** | **About 40 minutes** |
| CPU usage after mashup | **2%** | Not otherwise changed/stated |
| Send/upload time | **Over 80 minutes** | Not otherwise stated as improved |
| Total refresh time | **Nearly 2 hours** | Not otherwise stated as improved |
| Data model size | **16 GB compressed** | **16.5 GB compressed** mentioned in the user’s follow-up as the similar setup they are asking about |
| Latency | Not stated initially | **129 to 136 ms** |
| Packet loss | Not stated initially | **None before or after tuning** |
| Expected refresh time with tables | Not stated initially | **Approximately 34 minutes** |

## Explicitly mentioned environment/setup

- **Power BI Gateway** running on a **virtual machine**
- VM specs:
  - **32 GB RAM**
  - **16-core processor**
- Data source / path mentioned in follow-up:
  - **Oracle → Gateway → Power BI Service**
- Current use:
  - **Views**
- Considered alternative:
  - **Tables**
